displayName: [Preview]: Microsoft Foundry Guardrails should automatically enforce an ACS policy baseline
description: For ACS-format Guardrails, automatically enforce the whole baseline selected by its full ARM resource ID alongside the customer policy. Enforced Deny requests service-managed composition before the final check and blocks the write if the baseline cannot be enforced. Audit reports compliance without changes.

metadata.description: Audit, deny, or disable this requirement.
Full ARM resource ID of the existing accounts/raiPolicies ACS baseline whose entire policy must be satisfied. This is a resource reference, not a local manifest key or a single-point binding.
